newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR MOSTLY EASIER AHEAD OF WEEKEND.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR MOSTLY EASIER AHEAD OF WEEKEND.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted weaker agaisnt most key currencies at the close of a rather lacklustre interbank trading session on Friday, dealers said.

"The dollar closed where it opened (against the key U.S. unit. Nothing much happened today," one dealer said, adding however that the local currency registered movements against other units during the day in reflection of overseas market activity.
The local dollar closed at 11.3125/3225 on the U.S. dollar, unchanged from where it was in the morning, but weaker compared to Thursday's 11.3100/3200.

It was also quoted easier on sterling at 18.7300/7500 compared to 18.6100/6300 and at 2.5100/5300 against the rand from 2.5000/5200 but was a touch firmer on the mark at 6.5400/5600 against 6.5500/5700 the previous day.
